headline: Sudan Prime Minister Exsumpts Key Commodities from Customs Duties and VAT
summary: Sudan's Prime Minister issued a decision exempting a specified list of commodities from customs duties and taxes, including value-added tax.
why: Tariff and tax exemptions on essential goods serve as immediate fiscal interventions to alleviate domestic consumer price pressures.

impacts.name: Sudan
impacts.why: Lifting import taxes reduces immediate retail prices for basic goods while temporarily lowering government tariff revenues.
